highest_priority_missing_edges: A single native specialist catalog/selector and archive dispatcher: it must call only input-derived admission, include all paid metadata, and decode every selected frame without Python.
PAQ worker/supervisor integration for v215 and v216 with exact CIXP mapping, plus joint-discount and store-state variants for their distinct CIXB envelopes.

Executable CIXB backend and route completion: SectionPointers/PdataSymbols and their ECSL1/ECPD1/ECPD2 chain now compile as library transforms, but the joint-discount and filtered frames still need their exact native PAQ/Brotli/store-state stacks, candidate admission, and top-level decoder dispatch.
Native candidate/decoder bindings for already-library-only chemical, database, volume/JXL and multiscale routes.
Grouped-grid and LSTM/prediction routes, which have no identified native implementation and correspond to historical portfolio winners.
Mixed-region CIXH carrier and region selection, absent from native source; this is separate from whole-file specialist selection.
acceptance_per_route: For each retained route: source-to-archive parity fixture where applicable; fresh native encode; separate archive-only native decode; malformed/limit tests; resource accounting; no Python process or PATH lookup; and candidate/decoder registration evidence.
